name: Accident statement · 1 accident & sketch
description: European accident statement: boxes 1-5 and the sketch (box 13).

fields.name: accident_date
fields.description: Box 1: date of the accident, written day/month/year.

fields.name: accident_time
fields.description: Box 1: time of the accident as HH:MM, 24-hour.

fields.name: accident_country
fields.description: Box 2: country of the accident as ISO alpha-2, e.g. BE.

fields.name: accident_city
fields.description: Box 2: city or municipality of the accident.

fields.name: accident_street
fields.description: Box 2: street and number of the accident location.

fields.name: accident_injuries
fields.description: Box 3: true if 'yes' ('oui' / 'ja') is ticked for injuries, false if 'no' is ticked.

fields.name: accident_damage_to_other_vehicles
fields.description: Box 4: true if material damage to vehicles other than A and B is ticked 'yes'.

fields.name: accident_damage_to_other_objects
fields.description: Box 4: true if material damage to objects other than vehicles is ticked 'yes'. The sample forms have one yes/no for box 4; use the same answer.

fields.name: accident_witnesses
fields.description: Box 5: witnesses (names, addresses, phone) as written; null if empty or a dash.

fields.name: sketch_road_layout
fields.description: Box 13: the road layout drawn in the sketch.

enum_options.name: straight_road
enum_options.description: A straight road, one lane each way

enum_options.name: multi_lane_road
enum_options.description: A road with several lanes in the same direction

enum_options.name: parking_lot
enum_options.description: A car park or parking spaces

fields.name: sketch_description
fields.description: Box 13: one sentence describing the sketch: road layout, where A and B are and which way they move at impact.

rules.name: Accident date is not in the future
